description: Baseline: focused heapsort benchmark via autoresearch.sh (build + fresh state + loadstring + execute returned function)
Bind luaL_loadstring with string|number so long Lua chunks use a direct UTF-8 buffer path instead of generic ccall string marshaling
Tried routing long luaL_loadstring calls through luaL_loadbufferx to avoid C strlen, but the extra JS-side length/allocation work regressed the heapsort benchmark
Call exported wasm functions directly for lua_callk/lua_pcallk when available, bypassing ccall on hot numeric-only call paths
Tried broader direct-export bindings for state/stack helpers (luaL_newstate/lua_close/lua_newthread/lua_absindex/lua_gettop/lua_settop/lua_rotate), but it regressed badly and increased variance
Call exported wasm luaL_loadstring directly with a manually allocated UTF-8 buffer, avoiding ccall overhead on the hot chunk-load path
Tried direct-export binding for luaL_openselectedlibs to cut state setup overhead, but the heapsort benchmark regressed slightly
Tried caching the most recent UTF-8 buffer for luaL_loadstring to avoid repeated string encoding, but it did not beat the current best on the heapsort workload
Tried direct-export binding for lua_close, but closing states through the raw export regressed the heapsort benchmark noticeably
Tried lazily creating FunctionTypeExtension callback threads to reduce state setup work, but the heapsort benchmark regressed
Tried lazy-instantiating type extensions so plain states avoid eager metatable/setup work, but the heapsort benchmark regressed significantly
Tried calling exported wasm luaL_newstate directly to cut state-creation ccall overhead, but it regressed the heapsort benchmark
Tried implementing luaL_loadstring via direct exported luaL_loadbufferx with JS-computed byte length to avoid C strlen, but the extra JS-side encoding/allocation cost regressed badly
Tried reusing a heap buffer for direct luaL_loadstring UTF-8 encoding to avoid malloc/free churn, but it still regressed versus the current best
Tried assigning raw wasm exports directly for lua_callk/lua_pcallk and relying on JS null-to-zero coercion, but it regressed sharply despite being functionally correct
Tried specializing lua_callk/lua_pcallk wrappers for the common no-continuation case by always passing k=0, but that still regressed on the heapsort workload
Tried hoisting raw wasm export references into local constants inside wrapper setup to cut per-call property lookups, but it regressed substantially
Tried insertion-ordered type extension registration to avoid sorting on each createState, but it regressed sharply on the heapsort benchmark
Tried an ASCII fast path for direct exported luaL_loadstring using manual malloc/stringToUTF8 to avoid stringToNewUTF8 work, but it regressed badly
Tried hoisting only the raw exported luaL_loadstring reference into a local constant to reduce property lookups, but it still regressed heavily
